content: 'Settle up' / record-payment is a core, expected feature: users record that a debt was paid (cash, bank transfer, or through integrated payment rails like Venmo/PayPal in some apps). Recording a settlement is modeled the same as an expense but with reversed sign/effect on balances ('negative expense' pattern the project already decided on). Settle-up combined with debt-simplification ('simplify debts' toggle) reduced an example 8-payment settle-up down to 3 payments — simplification is presented as an optional toggle, not forced behavior, since some users want direct 1:1 accountability of who-paid-whom rather than optimized indirect payments.
